# OSS Security Knowledge Base: `org.springframework.security:spring-security-core` (Maven)

## Overview

**Package:** `org.springframework.security:spring-security-core`  
**Ecosystem:** Maven (Java)  
**Repository:** [spring-projects/spring-security](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-security)  
**OSV Listing:** [osv.dev](https://osv.dev/list?ecosystem=Maven&q=org.springframework.security%3Aspring-security-core)  
**Total Known Advisories:** 31  
**Date Reviewed:** July 2025

Spring Security is the de-facto standard for securing Spring-based applications. Given its ubiquity, it has been the subject of numerous security advisories spanning over 15 years. The vulnerabilities cluster into several recurring categories: **authorization/authentication bypasses**, **cryptographic weaknesses**, **method security annotation issues**, and **injection/deserialization flaws**.

---

## Vulnerability Categories

### 1. Authorization & Authentication Bypass

The largest and most impactful category. These vulnerabilities allow attackers to circumvent security constraints through URL path manipulation, regex misconfiguration, dispatcher type handling, annotation resolution failures, or improper authentication logic.
